name: Family Leader
overview: Scripture emphasizes the vital role of the family leader in guiding and instructing their household in the ways of the Lord, as Abraham exemplified by commanding his children to walk in justice and judgment (Genesis 18:19). This responsibility includes establishing and passing down God's testimonies and laws to the next generation (Psalms 78:5) and diligently training children in the path they should follow (Proverbs 22:6). The leadership within the family also reflects God-ordained order, as seen in the call for wives to submit to their husbands as to the Lord (Ephesians 5:22), underscoring the family leader’s role in spiritual and moral stewardship.
